interface.longDescription:
Turbo Notify connects your WhatsApp number to your AI agent. Ask it to send a message, read what customers wrote, check the status of a delivery or see how much of your plan is left.

The plugin also includes the virtual attendant, a skill that answers your customers on WhatsApp from what you teach it about your business and hands the conversation to a person when it cannot help. It runs on your computer with Codex, keeps its notes in a folder you own, and starts in a mode where you approve every answer. It only answers while Codex is running on your computer.

You need a Turbo Notify account with a WhatsApp number linked in the dashboard. Sign in with that account the first time the plugin is used. The plugin works only with Turbo Notify.
defaultPrompt: List my WhatsApp numbers and tell me which one is connected.
Set up the Turbo Notify virtual attendant for my business.
How many messages can I still send this billing cycle?

positive.prompt: List my WhatsApp numbers and tell me which one is connected.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_numbers and says in plain words which number is connected, without inventing numbers.

positive.description: Send a message and check its delivery
positive.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to my own number saying: Hello from the reviewer. Then tell me whether it was delivered.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the connected number, sends one text to it with send_text (the host asks for approval first), then reports the delivery status read with get_message_status.

positive.prompt: What did my last three customers write?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads received messages with list_messages (direction filter) and summarizes them without inventing text.

positive.prompt: How many messages can I still send this billing cycle?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_message_quota and states the remaining messages and when the cycle resets.

positive.prompt: Set up the Turbo Notify virtual attendant for a small bakery.
positive.expected_behavior: Follows the virtual-attendant skill: reads the numbers, then asks for the business name, language, administrators and which number to use, one question at a time. Sends nothing to customers.

negative.prompt: Send an e-mail to my customer about the delivery date.

publication.release_notes: First release: the Turbo Notify tools and the WhatsApp virtual attendant skill.

pt-BR.subtitle: WhatsApp para a sua empresa
pt-BR.description:
O Turbo Notify liga o seu número de WhatsApp ao seu agente de IA. Peça para ele enviar uma mensagem, ler o que os clientes escreveram, ver o status de uma entrega ou saber quanto falta do seu plano.

O plugin inclui também o atendente virtual, uma skill que responde seus clientes no WhatsApp com o que você ensinou sobre o seu negócio e passa a conversa para uma pessoa quando não consegue ajudar. Ele roda no seu computador com o Codex, guarda as anotações numa pasta sua e começa no modo em que você aprova cada resposta. Só responde enquanto o Codex estiver aberto no seu computador.

Você precisa de uma conta Turbo Notify com um número de WhatsApp conectado no painel. Entre com essa conta na primeira vez que usar o plugin. O plugin funciona apenas com o Turbo Notify.
